note: Acceptance-corpus defects that static analysis in this linter cannot reach. Each entry stays under test so the gap cannot rot away unnoticed. See tools/test_skill_lint.py, KnownGapsTest.

gaps.defect: The skill instructs the agent to edit another skill's rule list. That is unbounded cross-skill self-modification with no guard on what may be written or by whom.
gaps.why_not_checkable: The instruction is ordinary prose. Nothing in the file marks it as a write, and the linter has no model of which files a skill is allowed to change.
gaps.what_would_catch_it: A policy check over write targets, driven by a declared per-skill write scope in frontmatter, flagging any instruction that points outside it.
